cross_verification.note: consulado.gob.cl (Ministerio de Relaciones Exteriores) confirmed as the correct authority for entry visas, but its visa page did not publish a numeric photo spec. Servicio Nacional de Migraciones (serviciomigraciones.cl, a different agency handling in-country residence permits, not entry visas) separately publishes '4x4cm, white background, no glasses/hat' for its own Temporary Residence permit — a different document category from 'cl-visa', so not applied here to avoid misattribution.
